label: D2: reached S1 after a rewarded trial, early in episode (strongest on rare a2->S1)
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only when the reached state is S1 (100% of activations), almost always when the previous trial was rewarded (97% of activations, 96% of mass). It is strongly confined to the first ~40 trials of an episode (peak at trials 10-19, essentially silent after trial 50), so it is gated by something that drifts over the episode rather than by trial events alone. Magnitude is largest when S1 is reached by a rare transition after choosing a2 (a2->S1 holds 74% of mass from 59% of activations; top examples are all rare a2->S1 after reward) and when the policy had leaned to a2. It never fires at D1 or GO, never on S2, and rarely after an unrewarded trial. All variables are observable at D2. Precision is low (~0.23) because many early common a1->S1 D2 steps after reward stay silent; adding action==2 raises precision to 0.49 but cuts recall to 0.57 (dev F1 0.53 vs 0.37), so I recorded the higher-recall, simpler predicate.
